description: This file defines React components for a customizable dialog/modal interface using Radix UI primitives and Lucide icons. It includes components such as Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogOverlay, DialogContent, and others, often wrapping Radix primitives for styling and composition.

methods.name: Dialog
methods.description: A React component that wraps Radix UI's Dialog.Root, passing through all props and adding a data-slot for styling.

methods.name: DialogTrigger
methods.description: A React component that wraps Radix UI's Dialog.Trigger, passing through all props and adding a data-slot.

methods.name: DialogPortal
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's Dialog.Portal, with data-slot for styling.

methods.name: DialogClose
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's Dialog.Close, with data-slot for styling.

methods.name: DialogOverlay
methods.description: A component rendering Radix UI's Dialog.Overlay with custom styling, overlay effects, and a data-slot.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: Component rendering the dialog content wrapped in a portal, overlay, and Radix Content, with styling and close button.

methods.name: DialogHeader
methods.description: A styled div for dialog header content.

methods.name: DialogFooter
methods.description: A styled div for dialog footer actions.

methods.name: DialogTitle
methods.description: Component wrapping Radix UI's Dialog.Title with styling.

methods.name: DialogDescription
methods.description: Component wrapping Radix UI's Dialog.Description with styling.
